name: "The Purist" Mitchell Davis
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (19 February 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-matchwriter-with-sample-1999-02-19.html: a 222-pound, old-school wrestler from Greensboro, North Carolina, who idolises Frank Gotch, Jim Londos and Lou Thesz
caption: An old-school challenger who loses an MCWF title match when his former manager, disguised as an old lady, holds his foot, then chases the manager into the path of an ambulance, in a sample match of the September 1998 supercard.

name: Johnny Blaster Jr.
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (19 February 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-matchwriter-with-sample-1999-02-19.html: a 245-pound, 19-year-old heel champion from Duluth, Minnesota, brother of the commissioner
caption: The MCWF's 19-year-old heel champion, billed as the youngest in wrestling history, who retains his title over Mitchell Davis when a disguised Commander Cody holds the challenger down.
